correctness.rationale: Finite permutation isomorphism classes biject exactly to bounded-multiplicity partitions. Independent truncated-geometric Boltzmann variables conditioned on total size give the uniform model; verified Fourier decay and Lyapunov estimates imply span-one local CLT even after omitting finitely many coordinates. Hanf locality reduces all FO sentences to Boolean functions of finitely many short-cycle counts. Every cylinder is definable. Exact independent checker reproduced 1,134 finite identities, explicitly separated from asymptotic proof.

originality.rationale: Neither the established unrestricted uniform-isomorphism-class zero-one law nor existing logical convergence frameworks entail nontrivial (r+1)-adic spectra of the bounded-cycle model without an additional restricted-part equidistribution theorem. Current relevant literature and research records were compared at the statement/implication level; the possibility of a hidden stronger antecedent is documented, not erased.
residual_risks: A classic Fristedt-style conditioning theorem, together with first-order locality, could subsume parts or all of the result; exhaustive historical exclusion is not claimed.
A higher-level first-order convergence theorem for restricted conjugacy-class distributions may not be indexed by searched terminology.
The Markström–Räty primary full text and the Corteel et al. publisher full text were not fully inspected, so conclusions are limited to material actually read.

value.rationale: Bounding the count of cycles of each fixed length is a canonical, motivated distinct-part/bounded-repeat partition restriction. The precise arithmetic spectrum changes from the established unrestricted model zero-one law to all base-(r+1) fractions. The theorem gives a natural complete classification across every fixed cap, as well as algorithmic sentence limits; neither correctness alone nor an arbitrary cutoff motivates it.
